title: WorldPhy: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Physical Plausibility of World Models in Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2611.34130v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World models are increasingly used in robotics to improve the performance of embodied models. Compared with general-purpose video generation, robotics places more stringent requirements on world models. Generated videos must satisfy fine-grained physical constraints on robot motion and object interactions. However, existing world model benchmarks can overlook robotics specific physical details and struggle to assess them accurately. To address this problem, we introduce WorldPhy, a world model benchmark for accurate, fine-grained evaluation of physical plausibility in robotics. Our benchmark contains 300 tasks, each consisting of an initial-frame image and a task instruction, covering diverse robotics scenes, task categories, viewpoints, and robot configurations. We further collect over 12K high-quality human annotations, and use them to train WorldPhyReward to accurately provide scores and reasons across six fine-grained physical dime

translated_title: WorldPhy：面向机器人领域世界模型细粒度物理合理性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 世界模型在机器人领域的应用日益增多，用于提升具身模型的性能。与通用视频生成相比，机器人领域对世界模型提出了更为严格的要求：生成的视频必须满足关于机器人运动和物体交互的细粒度物理约束。然而，现有的世界模型基准往往会忽视机器人领域特有的物理细节，并难以对其进行准确评估。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 WorldPhy，一个用于对机器人领域物理合理性进行准确、细粒度评估的世界模型基准。该基准包含 300 个任务，每个任务由一张初始帧图像和一个任务指令组成，涵盖多样的机器人场景、任务类别、视角和机器人配置。我们进一步收集了超过 12K 条高质量的人工标注，并利用它们训练了 WorldPhyReward，以在六个细粒度物理维度上准确地提供评分与理由。
tldr: 提出了 WorldPhy 基准，通过 300 个机器人任务和基于 12K 人工标注训练的 WorldPhyReward 奖励模型，实现对世界模型生成视频在六个细粒度物理维度上的合理性评估。
en_tdlr: Proposes WorldPhy, a benchmark comprising 300 robotics tasks and a reward model (WorldPhyReward) trained on over 12K human annotations to accurately evaluate the fine-grained physical plausibility of videos generated by world models across six physical dimensions.
